beats.intro: Unit eleven, chapter fifty-seven. [[sub]]Square roots and cube roots undo squaring and cubing.
beats.square: Squaring a number gives the area of a square. [[side]]A square with side seven [[fill]]holds seven times seven, forty-nine unit squares. [[rev]]Taking a square root goes backward: start from the area, forty-nine, and ask how long the side is. [[sign]]We write it with a radical sign: the square root of forty-nine [[ans]]is seven, because seven squared is forty-nine.
beats.pm: Here's a subtlety. [[both]]Four squared is sixteen, and negative four squared is also sixteen, since a negative times a negative is positive. [[two]]So sixteen has two square roots: four and negative four. [[prin]]The radical sign means only the nonnegative one, called the principal square root. [[ans]]The square root of sixteen is four, not plus or minus four.
beats.neg: What about the square root of negative nine? [[sq]]Any real number times itself is positive, or zero. [[none]]So no real number squared gives negative nine. [[nr]]The square root of a negative number is not a real number.
beats.perfect: A perfect square is the square of a rational number. [[list]]One, four, nine, sixteen, twenty-five, and so on. [[frac]]Fractions can be perfect squares too: forty-nine thirty-sixths is seven sixths, squared, [[fans]]so its square root is seven sixths. [[rat]]The square root of a perfect square is rational. [[not]]Twenty isn't a perfect square. [[between]]Its square root lies between four and five, because sixteen is less than twenty, which is less than twenty-five. [[approx]]It's about four point four seven, [[irr]]but no decimal stops or repeats: the square root of twenty is irrational. The decimal is only an approximation.
beats.cube: Cubing works with volume. [[build]]A cube with edge five [[fill]]holds five times five times five, one hundred twenty-five unit cubes. [[rev]]The cube root goes backward, from the volume to the edge. [[sign]]We write a small three on the radical sign. [[ans]]The cube root of one hundred twenty-five is five.
beats.cubeneg: Unlike square roots, cube roots work for negative numbers. [[ex]]Negative five times negative five is twenty-five, [[three]]and twenty-five times negative five is negative one hundred twenty-five. [[ans]]So the cube root of negative one hundred twenty-five is negative five. [[one]]Every real number has exactly one real cube root, with the same sign as the number. [[frac]]Fractions too: the cube root of one twenty-seventh is one third.
beats.wrap: To sum up. [[w1]]The square root of a number is the nonnegative number that squares to it. [[w2]]Negative numbers have no real square root. [[w3]]The square root of a perfect square is rational; otherwise it's irrational. [[w4]]The cube root undoes cubing and works for negative numbers too. [[end]]Now try the chapter practice.

beats.finish: Well done. That's the end of chapter fifty-seven, square roots and cube roots.
